description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'ResetDatabaseCommand' for the OrangeHRM project. The class, extending a base Command class, provides functionality to reset the database to its initial state by invoking the DatabaseBackupService. It includes configuration for command naming and description, and an execute method performing the reset operation and outputting success message.

classes.name: ResetDatabaseCommand
classes.description: Defines a console command to reset the database to its initial state, used within the OrangeHRM test framework.

methods.description: Returns the command name identifier used in CLI execution.

methods.description: Sets the command description for help and usage information.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the database reset process and outputs success message.
